title: Backup snapshot manifest, format 1
description: manifest.json inside <picked>/<app>/snapshots/<UTC stamp>/. Written last; a snapshot directory without a manifest that parses is invalid. See backup-format.md.

app.description: App directory name under the picked folder, e.g. engram or chronicles.

appVersion.description: Free-form build identifier (version, commit, or date).

createdAt.description: UTC, second precision, RFC 3339 with a Z suffix. The snapshot directory name is this value with ':' replaced by '-'.

fingerprint.description: Opaque, app-defined summary of the live data at snapshot time. Only compared for equality by the same app.

integrity.description: Result of PRAGMA integrity_check on the snapshot. Only verified snapshots are published.

counts.description: App-defined row counts; keys are free-form.

attachments.description: Every attachment at snapshot time. Each blob lives at attachments/<sha256[0:2]>/<sha256><ext> beside snapshots/, where <ext> is the lowercased extension of name if it matches ^\.[a-z0-9]{1,10}$, else empty.

name.description: Path relative to the app's attachments directory, '/'-separated. Readers must reject '..' segments.
